release_notes.en-US: Tab Snooze System: inactive tabs auto-unload from memory to save RAM. UI polish, Firebase security hardening, automated CI/CD pipeline.

summary.en-US: Reduce memory usage and reclaim your focus by collapsing all open tabs into a single, searchable dashboard.

description.en-US:
**Lorapok TabMan** is a next-generation Firefox tab manager built for power users.

**Key Features:**

- ⚡ **One-Click Collapse** — Save all open tabs and close them instantly, reclaiming up to 95% of tab memory
- 😴 **Tab Snooze** — Automatically unloads inactive tabs from memory after a configurable timeout (1 min – 7 days)
- ☁️ **Cloud Sync** — Sign in with Google to sync your tab groups across all devices via Firebase
- 📁 **Smart Groups** — Organize tabs into named groups with stars, locks, and hierarchical tags
- ⌨️ **Keyboard Shortcuts** — Navigate and manage at lightning speed
- 📊 **Memory Analytics** — Visualize how much RAM you've reclaimed
- 📦 **Bulk Operations** — Multi-select tagging, archiving, and deletion
- 🔄 **OneTab Migration** — Import your existing OneTab sessions instantly

Open source under Apache-2.0. Built with passion in Bangladesh by Lorapok Labs.
